items.title: Meta Brings Code Review Auto-Approval More Mainstream with PyTorch GreenLight
items.text: PyTorch now lets an AI reviewer approve pull requests from its own maintainers. GreenLight is an open-source take on RADAR, the system Meta uses to auto-land low-risk diffs after safety checks, a risk score and an LLM review. OpenAI, Anthropic and Sonar describe similar ways to automate approval while keeping humans on risky changes. By Andrew Hoblitzell
